title: Documentation Update and Code Cleanup
description: Update README.md and GEMINI.md for 2D array. Remove unused simulate method. Finalize visualization stability.

title: Fix Visualizer Orientation
description: Align theta=0 to point vertically down in both the RotorArrayVisualizer and the MeanDirectionVisualizer color wheel.

title: Implement 2D Rotor Array Visualizer
description: Update visualizer.py to render an L x L grid of discs with HSL coloring (Hue=angle, Luminosity=kinetic energy).

title: Implement Adaptive Sub-stepping
description: Numerical stability in the Velocity Verlet integrator depends on the time step resolving the highest frequency modes (~sqrt(J+M)). Implement adaptive sub-stepping in SimulationEngine that scales 'substeps' based on real-time J and M values to prevent energy divergence at high coupling without wasting CPU at low coupling.

title: Unify Color Mapping Logic
description: The math-angle to visual-hue mapping is currently duplicated in RotorArrayVisualizer and MeanDirectionVisualizer. Centralize this logic into a shared utility function to ensure consistent color interpretation across all UI components and facilitate future palette adjustments.

title: Add Mean Direction Visualizer
description:
Implement a dedicated visualizer in the control panel to show the mean direction vector (order parameter) as a **disc** statically colored by HSV (angle->hue, etc)  values with a black "slit" pointing in the direction of the order parameter with length equal to r times the radius of the disk.

The disc and the pointer should be oriented so that angle zero corresponds to downward direction.

title: Update UI and Integration for 2D Array
description: Update ui.py and main.py to handle lattice size L instead of N, and integrate the new visualizer.

title: Align Angle-Color Mapping
description: Update RotorArrayVisualizer to use HSV instead of HSL to match MeanDirectionVisualizer and ensure consistent angle-to-color mapping.

title: Enhance Thermalized Preset
description: Add an energy parameter to the Thermalized preset and use it to scale the initial velocity distribution (sigma = sqrt(2 * epsilon)).

title: Optimize Lattice Rendering
description: Current rendering uses pg.ScatterPlotItem with a Python loop to create QBrush objects for every rotor, which scales O(N) and bottlenecks at L > 40. Optimization should switch to pg.ImageItem, allowing the entire RGB buffer to be computed via NumPy vectorization (HSV to RGB) and passed to the GPU in a single call.

title: Make Direction Visualizer Background Transparent
description: Set the background of the MeanDirectionVisualizer widget and its plot to transparent so that only the color-wheel disc and slit are visible against the control panel.

title: Implement 2D Rotor Array Physics
description: Update simulation.py to support L x L lattice with periodic boundary conditions and 4 nearest-neighbor coupling.

title: Fix Visualization Clipping on Reset
description: Ensure the RotorArrayVisualizer correctly resets its view range and disc sizes when the simulation is re-initialized with new presets or lattice sizes to prevent clipping.

title: Cleanup and Final Verification
description: Remove old 1D code and ensure all tests pass.
